source: Class weights and method entries from the green full main run 45520267476 on 4cf5156a, 2026-11-25, after #955 and #959: each class weight is the sum of its passing per-test durations in the Mac core tests jobs (CI mode, -O, three concurrent shard processes per runner), and each method entry is that test's duration in the same run. A test reported twice, for example re-run in isolation by scripts/core-test-time-guard.py, keeps its maximum duration. The classes that run did not execute keep their earlier values: LiveOwnedJobInspectionTests, RelayConnectorProcessTests, SignedReleaseInspectionTests. GatewayRuntimeActivationOperationTests comes from PR run 45546462155 (#971, which splits its interrupted-stage test per stage), the sum of its 15 tests' maximum durations.
